entry.title: New: dsh-session-recovery
entry.summary: Recover deleted or corrupted dsh sessions (session.jsonl.zstd) and memory (memory.db) from the raw disk, and repair rebuilt sessions that fail to resume via the /session-repair command in the web UI. Exact install spec: github:coprexist/dsh-session-recovery. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
